title: Fox Keynotes San Luis Potosí Business Fair, Calls for 'New Industrial Revolution'
detail: Vicente Fox delivers the keynote address at the 4th annual Feria de la Proveeduría 2026, a business-linkage fair hosted by the San Luis Potosí capital government under Mayor Enrique Galindo, praising the initiative for connecting local suppliers with larger firms. Fox urges Mexico to seize its current economic moment to drive 'a new industrial revolution,' highlighting the region's manufacturing and automotive sectors as growth engines — echoing the nearshoring themes he championed at the May 2026 Eagle Pass trade summit.
